title: In charts: how power could shift in Europe’s big year of elections
summary_full: More than half of EU voters will go to the polls in the next 12 months, with the far right targeting significant gains. We set out the political landscape and trendsEurope is entering a ‘supercycle’ of national elections. Their outcomes could shake the EU’s foundationsOver the coming 12 months, more than half of the EU’s electorate will go to the polls in elections that could change the direction of the continent, with attention focused on voters in four of the bloc’s five biggest states.In Spain, France and Poland, elections could bring the far right into government. Italy’s far-right prime minister looks likely to remain in power, but is under pressure from a challenger even further to the right. Continue reading...
